Ensemble as an app

Coding agents

Feedback

Agent models

What an agent the hub starts runs on when its seat names no model: task owners, reviewers, POs, handovers and PO switches. A seat that names a model keeps it. A change applies from each agent's next start. It is passed at launch: Claude's and Codex's own settings are never changed.

The default for task owners, reviewers and owner handovers, including tasks in no project. Each project can override it from its menu. A change applies only when an agent is launched or resumed after the change; POs and sessions you open from history keep your own tools.

Pace each agent's week
points

A kind whose 7-day use is past the share of the week gone by, plus the head start, is ahead of pace (15 points: about 15% at a reset, 43% after two days, the warning from day 4.6). A new owner, review or handover then goes to the other kind while that one is not. In a week's last 12 hours what is left would be lost at the reset, so that kind is not paced and is used up to the alarm. Pacing never stops work, and a task set to keep its agents is not paced.

Preferences

What the agents call you

Used in the collaboration briefing, so agents address you by name instead of “the human.” Empty = your git user.name.

Call an agent stalled after seconds

🔔 An agent that was asked to do something, isn't working, and hasn't reported back for this long is listed as needing you. Both CLIs redraw a working indicator while they think, so an agent busy for hours is never counted.

Start the PO afresh past tokens

Every wake of a project's PO re-sends its whole conversation. Past this size the PO brings PO-HANDOVER.md up to date and a fresh session picks up from it and ROADMAP.md; the old conversation is kept. 0 = never.

Start a task's owner afresh past tokens

The same for the engineer (or only agent) of a running task: it writes TASK-HANDOVER.md in the task folder and a fresh session carries on from it. 0 = never.

RTK for task agents

Compresses command output for task owners and reviewers on their next launch. PO rooms, adopted sessions and your own terminals are never changed.

Call a board

The word every screen uses for a board of tasks with its PO, on every device of this hub. Only what you read changes: agents and file names stay as they are. The page reloads to show it.

Backup of your projects

Your projects and their tasks live in one folder that the app keeps as a git repository. Give it a remote and it commits & pushes on a schedule — so a new machine gets every project and the knowledge built inside it.

Git remote (optional)

Only the URL is stored. Authentication uses this machine's git credential manager or SSH key — the app never sees a password or token.

Rearrange existing sessions

One-shot actions. Won't touch preferences.

This instance

Read-only. Override with ENSEMBLE_* env vars at start time — see the README.

A PO has no spec: its conversation is where the work is asked for. Open a task to read its spec and details here.
